create_roberta_config: create a RobertaConfig instance with default model settings for the RoBERTa transformer architecture
initialize_roberta_model: initialize a RoBERTa model by passing a RobertaConfig to RobertaModel constructor
access_model_config: access the model configuration from a RobertaModel instance via the config attribute
customize_roberta_hyperparameters: customize RobertaConfig hyperparameters like hidden_size, num_hidden_layers, and num_attention_heads
configure_roberta_token_ids: configure RobertaConfig token IDs including pad_token_id, bos_token_id, and eos_token_id
